task_instructions: Pick the gray slanted panel with text up, rotate it, and ensure the QR code faces you.
Pick up the rectangular plastic paymentsign and adjust its position to face the qrcode towards you.
Take the gray top with QR code, raise it, and make the qrcode face you.
Take the smooth plastic paymentsign with QR code, raise it, and make the qrcode face you.
Using the left arm, catch the triangular stand with QR code and rotate it to face the QR code.
